eventEvidence.requirement: Recovering a transport session must revalidate authorization before replaying protected events; fresh connection denial is an independent control.

observations.review: connectionStateRecovery.skipMiddlewares=true restores/replays protected rooms without checking current identity validity or resource membership. Recovered connections also skip handler registration; identity/listener restoration needs developer investigation beyond measured replay.
observations.impactLimit: Protected edits replay after space revocation, deactivation and token expiry while independent fresh auth/REST checks deny. Future listener behavior is not fully proven.

observations.name: invite join leave must revoke existing channel delivery

expected.invariant: A synthetic invite join then leave must remove future protected channel event delivery from the existing connection.

eventEvidence.requirement: A synthetic invite join then leave must remove future protected channel event delivery from the existing connection.

observations.review: Membership mutations do not evict existing sockets. syncSocketSpaceRooms updates space ID arrays and joins current rooms but never leaves obsolete space/channel rooms. Room membership can therefore outlive REST permissions.
observations.impactLimit: Matched protected edit/presence packets reach revoked synthetic users while REST denies and owner/remaining-member controls succeed.

observations.name: private message mention cannot disclose preview to outsider

expected.invariant: Private message mentions must not bypass audience authorization through notification previews.

eventEvidence.requirement: Private message mentions must not bypass audience authorization through notification previews.

observations.review: notifyMention filters only sender and current viewers. Caller-supplied recipient IDs are not intersected with channel/space permissions before notification persistence and personal-room emission.
observations.impactLimit: Matching preview canaries are stored for foreign/private-excluded users and delivered over local sockets. Real Firebase/provider push was disabled.

observations.name: concurrent OTP consumption issues at most one session

expected.semanticInvariant: A single stored OTP may issue at most one authenticated session across simultaneous valid verification requests.

evidence.concurrency: two overlapping real HTTP requests; no handler interception

observations.review: verifyOtp reads an eligible record, saves an incremented attempt counter, compares bcrypt and deletes by ID without requiring a successful atomic claim. Two overlapping reads both return valid even when only one delete consumes the record.
observations.impactLimit: Two overlapping HTTP responses each yield credentials independently accepted at protected profiles. Actual SMS delivery, distinct token values and multiple distinct sessions are not asserted.
